column3: Close to the Hebrew; כִּי לֶקַח (“teaching”) is rendered “doctrine,” and “my torah” “my law.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the beginning of wisdom: get wisdom” is rendered “Wisdom is the principal thing; Therefore get wisdom.”
Close to the Hebrew; סַלְסְלֶהָ (“prize her”) is rendered “Exalt her.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a crown of beauty” is rendered “A crown of glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; “like the light of dawn” is rendered “like the shining sun,” and “the established day” “the perfect day.”
Close to the Hebrew; “more than all guarding” is rendered “with all diligence,” and “sources” “issues.”
Close to the Hebrew; פַּלֵּס (“make level”) is rendered “Ponder.”
